article.title: India’s Ruling Classes and the Global Crisis
article.author: Jamil Jonna
article.content: In September’s Review of the Month, the Research Unit for Political Economy delves into how the crisis pervading the world system, on stark display in the tech sector, global finance, and the sphere of production, lays bare the longstanding vulnerabilities of the Indian economy. As the contradictions in the neoliberal phase become unmistakable, the authors write, it is necessary to take a class-based approach to resolving the questions of how to bring about key questions regarding the productive life and development of India. The post India’s Ruling Classes and the Global Crisis appeared first on Monthly Review .
